name: Automattic / Jetpack / WordPress.com
description: Rete e servizi cloud di Automattic (AS2635) per sincronizzazione Jetpack, backup, statistiche e CDN.
expression: (ip.src.asnum eq 2635) or (http.user_agent contains "Jetpack") or (http.user_agent contains "WordPress.com") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-json/jetpack/")
